description.en-US: Segue, a music player, and MediaSync, version control for your music, photos, videos and games. The same signed APKs as the GitHub releases of github.com/tblisonb/Segue and github.com/tblisonb/MediaSync.

summary.en-US: Keeps your phone's music, photos, videos and games in sync with your own server

description.en-US:
The Android app of MediaSync, self-hosted version control for your music, photos, videos and games. One PC runs the MediaSync server and holds the library; the phone keeps a copy of the folders you pick, in sync with it, over your own Tailscale network.

* Every change (a retag, a rename, a deleted file) is a revision you can look at and undo, and nothing changes on the phone until you've seen what's coming.
* Music is filed by its tags, the same on every device, and a retag only sends the new tags.
* The camera's photos can be backed up to the server, filed by date.
* Movies, shows and games: the phone keeps only the ones you pick for it.

Needs the MediaSync server (github.com/tblisonb/MediaSync), Tailscale, and "All files access".

summary.en-US: Plays your music files and TIDAL in one queue, and scrobbles to Last.fm

description.en-US: A music player for your own music files, and TIDAL, in one queue. * Your library: browse by artist, album, song, folder and playlist, and search. A rescan reads only what changed. * Playback: gapless, with FFmpeg's decoders; volume levelling from ReplayGain tags, by track or by album; the media notification, lock screen and Bluetooth controls. * The queue: tapping a track plays its album, playlist, folder or search results from that track. Play next, Add to queue, shuffle and repeat. Segue picks up where you left off. * Playlists: .m3u8 files in Music/Playlists, which desktop players can read too. * TIDAL (needs a subscription): search, your favorites and playlists, playback up to 24-bit FLAC, and editing your playlists and favorites. * Last.fm: scrobbling, including scrobbles made offline, and your stats. * Appearance: Follow system, Light, Dark or Black, with your wallpaper's colours or one of nine accent colours. * MediaSync, if you use it: Segue rescans right after a sync, uses the loudness the server measures, and streams the server's tracks the phone doesn't keep. Needs "All files access" to read the Music folder.
